title: SRD: Help distracts only an enemy within 5 feet; engine: Help distracts any creature within 5 feet, even the helper's own companion

history.summary: `help_attack` (dungdra/actions.py) now refuses a target that isn't the helper's enemy. It doesn't add a new check: it reuses the team-based `game.enemies_of` that Hide and the other actions already use, so the whole opposing side counts as enemies (R-44). Someone on the helper's own side or a neutral creature can't be distracted. The refusal carries page=181, rule="GLOSS.enemy#1", ruling="R-44", and the code is tagged SRD[GLOSS.enemy#1]. The T-111 test passes with --runxfail. This also fixes T-112 (Help distracting a bystander who isn't fighting); its test now passes as a strict xpass too. There are two new unit tests: Help refuses to distract a companion and leaves no effect or log entry, and Help still distracts an adjacent enemy. The unit suite passes (565), ruff is clean and the dev-gate passes. In the srd and scenario suites the only failures are the T-111 and T-112 tests, which fail as strict xpasses because their xfail markers are still on; the harness removes those markers.
